target_system: dominant Japanese radiation plus age/sampling-matched comparison histories
why_high_information: Nature framing requires evidence that phenotype accumulation is genuinely rapid
minimum_linked_data: dated/calibratable nuclear topology ensemble; trait coverage; sampling fractions; comparison histories
stop_rule: if no acceleration after age/sampling controls drop exceptional-evolvability wording
claim_ceiling: rapid radiation age alone does not establish rapid phenotype evolution

why_high_information: colour has a tractable genotype-regulation-pigment chain and Azami has a robust chroma-radiation axis
minimum_linked_data: same-individual standardized colour; voucher; population genome; cytotype; floral tissue for selected systems; pigment chemistry
genomic_question: are repeated colour states built by shared old variants, introgression, or independent regulatory changes?
functional_followup: pollinator signalling and radiation/thermal tests only after molecular contrast is established
stop_rule: do not open untargeted transcriptomics without a discriminating genomic contrast
claim_ceiling: colour association with environment is not proof of adaptive pigment mechanism

target_system: replicated orientation states across multiple populations/lineages
why_high_information: EAzami has the strongest transition-level ecological pattern but no molecular origin test
minimum_linked_data: gravity-referenced orientation; same-individual genome; cytotype; voucher; population replication
genomic_question: do repeated orientation states reuse genomic regions/haplotypes?
stop_rule: do not infer causal loci from ancestry-correlated association alone
claim_ceiling: orientation transition ecology is not evidence of genomic reuse

target_system: JPN06 nonsticky / JPN15 sticky plus additional sticky/nonsticky systems
why_high_information: strong historical contrast and direct within-Cirsium functional context make stickiness a high-value replicated state
minimum_linked_data: direct stickiness/gland phenotype; genome; cytotype; voucher; replicated populations; dense resequencing if Tier1 informative
genomic_question: is stickiness associated with reusable or exchanged genomic material?
stop_rule: JPN06 restoration only after material-equivalence validation
claim_ceiling: sister/species contrast alone is not causal or proof of reuse

target_system: JPN36 phyllary state plus ancestry-matched relatives
why_high_information: EAzami gives a comparatively localized phyllary history that can anchor genomic-origin tests
minimum_linked_data: direct phyllary phenotype; same-individual genome; cytotype; voucher; relatives/populations
genomic_question: what genomic source underlies the JPN36-associated phyllary state?
stop_rule: if state is not population-stable or manipulation not feasible retain genomics only
claim_ceiling: localized transition is not proof of adaptation

target_system: polymorphic/contact-zone populations across repeated capitulum states
why_high_information: species-tip compression in 4/4 audited systems implies recent variation may still segregate
minimum_linked_data: dense within-population phenotype; genome; cytotype; plastid where informative; voucher
genomic_question: does recombination/admixture generate new combinations of head modules?
functional_followup: only trait-specific experiments with a predeclared mediator
stop_rule: no convenience population substitution after ancestry leverage is known
claim_ceiling: admixture association is not adaptive introgression without trait and fitness evidence

target_system: individuals/populations with multiple capitulum modules scored jointly
why_high_information: direct test of EAzami historical mosaic at the genomic level
minimum_linked_data: same-individual colour/orientation/phyllary/stickiness where possible plus dense genomic data
genomic_question: do different modules carry distinct local genomic histories that recombine into novel head configurations?
functional_followup: representative function/fitness chains for one or two modules
stop_rule: if module phenotypes are not repeatably measurable do not infer genomic modularity
claim_ceiling: different associated regions do not by themselves prove developmental modularity

target_system: independent Cirsium radiation/major lineage after Japanese discovery model is frozen
why_high_information: Nature-scale claim needs prediction beyond one Japanese radiation
minimum_linked_data: homologous phenotype states plus suitable genomic resources/sampling
genomic_question: does the Japanese reuse prediction replicate independently?
stop_rule: freeze predictions before opening replication outcome
claim_ceiling: failure weakens generality but does not invalidate the Japanese mechanism
